record.question: The main advantage of giving a drug via intravenous (I.V.) route is that:
options: It is the best route for depot preparations.
It causes less chance of developing thrombophlebitis.
record.explanation: Answer B: It provides 100% bioavailability.. Intravenous administration delivers the drug directly into systemic circulation, giving 100% bioavailability. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
